Restriction is school-only; no statewide adult facility or care ban for visitors. Mixed protections (19 municipal ordinances, sodomy repealed) offset by religious-refusal statute and no GI hate-crime coverage.

July 2026 worst-policies tier: public-facility misdemeanour (minor-present, intent-based), first-in-nation youth care ban reinstated on appeal, no GI hate-crime or non-discrimination law; adult exposures present though partially intent-gated.

Tier-1 universal exposure: 2026 statute criminalises birth-sex-mismatched restroom use everywhere including private businesses and hospitals, up to a year jailed — heavier than peers; no enforcement record yet but inescapable for every outed visitor.

Moderate-Risk tier: no adult facility or care ban; restrictions flow through appointed boards (youth care, school sports). Document changes available; municipal protections partial. Thinner recourse than protective states, but visitor-facing law is light.
